fe28d4b9621bca58ed130e078b61dc4f.overview: When her American lover visits London, a wealthy woman’s jealous husband hatches a plan to murder her and inherit her fortune.
fe28d4b9621bca58ed130e078b61dc4f.tagline: Is this the man she was waiting for... or the man who was waiting for her?

fe5087a8450e60a6be2d3573d1d3a3cc.overview: A platonic pair of former best friends approaching midlife reconnect after a long rift. The duo’s friendship becomes more consuming—and destabilizes their lives in a hilarious way.

fe50ebf3ddef8dac9303cc4a91651953.overview: On the eve of his wedding, on holiday on the Lake Annecy shore, career diplomat Jérôme visits an old acquaintance, perhaps a former girlfriend. Through her, he meets an intense teenager, Laura, and then lusts after her sister, Claire. Whilst Laura attempts to flirt with him, Jérôme's fantasy becomes focused on wanting to caress Claire's knee.

fe569d0f8fec6ff5a0f08451a1a7802a.overview: An aging hood is about to go back to prison. Hoping to escape his fate, he supplies information on stolen guns to the feds, while simultaneously supplying arms to his bank robbing chums.
fe569d0f8fec6ff5a0f08451a1a7802a.tagline: It’s a grubby, violent, dangerous world. But it’s the only world they know. And they’re the only friends Eddie has.

fe700cd69b5d34018730006165754178.overview: After a shipwreck, an intelligent robot called Roz is stranded on an uninhabited island. To survive the harsh environment, Roz bonds with the island's animals and cares for an orphaned baby goose.

feac84e0f765a932f2cf4bd7b88bd62b.overview: Following the death of her fiancé, Margot Weston is left pregnant and unmarried. Former doctor Jim Howard helps the desperate Margot. When her son is born, Jim helps her find a home for the baby with Phil Marshall and his wife. Margot insists that neither the Marshalls nor the child can ever know that she is his mother.
feac84e0f765a932f2cf4bd7b88bd62b.tagline: Why must it always be good-bye... when a woman loves like this ?

fefa5986b3fd5505b80f3c2e85e565b7.overview: Walt Disney's timeless masterpiece is an extravaganza of sight and sound! See the music come to life, hear the pictures burst into song and experience the excitement that is Fantasia over and over again.
fefa5986b3fd5505b80f3c2e85e565b7.tagline: The most sensational sound you'll ever see!
